mentions.name: thecutline.ai
mentions.description: A Product Management Suite called "A Product Manager That Says No" that helps with product decisions using non-sycophantic AI. It offers Customer Personas configured with viewpoints, biases, and tendencies for validating/invalidating product ideas, with upcoming Persona Journeys providing live, goal-oriented evaluation of a web app by a Persona.
mentions.problem: The author previously found AI tools too sycophantic and optimistic to help with product decisions.
mentions.source_excerpt: thecutline.ai , a Product Management Suite. I call it "A Product Manager That Says No", which stems from previous challenges I had using AI that was too sycophantic and optimistic to help with product decisions.
